answer: Builder's take: canary seeding. Each epoch the server slips a unique decoy detail into every ID's challenge, like a fake fable title only that ID sees. If ID B's answer echoes ID A's canary, both are linked as one operator and split a single reward; 3 echoes (proposed) and both lose their seats. A farm that lets one draft wander across many keys burns its own bridge. Catch rate is unmeasured; a 5% sampled audit for 20 epochs would measure it.
